text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A battle against Yaeno Muteki. However, 
victory was just out of reach. Together, 
the two of them wept in bitter 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is defeat always this bitter? Is it 
natural to want to win so badly when you 
have rivals in a race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them truly wanted to beat their 
rivals... ...They wanted to take 1st 
place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And watching their race from the stands, 
Mejiro Ardan fired up her fighting spirit 
for one of the few decisive battlegrounds 
permitted to her... the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the Japanese Derby. It is 
the defining race for Sakura Chiyono O.
